dress_code.men: Traditional attire preferred (Dhoti and Kurta, or formal trousers and shirts). Casual shorts or sleeveless vests are discouraged inside the inner sanctum.
dress_code.women: Traditional Indian attire such as Sarees, Salwar Kameez, or Churidars with Dupatta.

dos: Abide strictly by Srisaila Devasthanam regulations while viewing Archana Abhishekam and offering prayers.
Seek consent from Nandi (Sanagala Basavanna) before worshipping Lord Shiva.
Worship Lord Ganapathi (Suradhyaakshaaya) first before worshipping other deities.
Perform Goseva and treat cows with utmost sacredness as mothers embodying cosmic energy.
Worship Sami (Jammi) Vruksham on Vijayadashami and offer leaves to elders in return for blessings.
Offer Pradakshinas (Padmapradakshina and Sriramapradakshina) around Srisailam temple and sacred trees.
Safeguard the secret spiritual wisdom of Srisailam with care.
donts: Do not worship Lord Shiva first without worshipping Nandi (Sanagala Basavanna), as divinity comes through Dharma.
Do not forget to offer prayers to Lord Ganapathi when worshipping any deity.
Do not commit violence against snakes, directly or indirectly, or disturb their homes to avoid Nagadosha.
Do not reveal secret spiritual teachings gifted by devotion to individuals devoid of faith.
safety_guidelines: Follow devasthanam safety guidelines during holy baths in water bodies like Mallika Gundam, Rudradhara, and Pinakini river.
